question: How is the one reality related to the entire path from Śiva to the individual?
premises: There is one reality that pervades all levels from Śiva down to the individual.
This same reality constitutes the entire path.
The entire path abides in non-difference from Bhairava.
inference: The one all-pervading reality is identical with the entire path and remains non-different from Bhairava.
plain_english: The one reality, present in every state from Śiva to the limited individual, is this entire path itself, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.
